case_goal: To verify that a room can be added with specific details (name, description, capacity, admin email) in the MRBS system by an admin user.
summary: Admin logs into MRBS, navigates to Room management via the 'Rooms' link, fills in room details (name: 'test room', description: 'test description', capacity: 40, admin email: 'test@admin.com'), and submits the form to create a new room.

steps.expected_result: The admin login page loads successfully with username and password fields visible.
The username field is filled with 'admin'.
The password field is filled with 'admin'.
User is logged in and redirected to the admin panel page with navigation links (including 'Rooms') visible.
The Rooms management page is displayed, showing an area selector and the form to add a new room.
The 'Room Name' field is filled with 'test room'.
The 'Description' field is filled with 'test description'.
The 'Room Admin Email' field is filled with 'test@admin.com'.
The room is added successfully and the page reloads to the area management page showing the newly created room in the rooms list.
